    @pytest.mark.priority(21)
    @allure.title("Verify Delete Tobacco Entry: Clicking delete icon and confirming dialog reduces history row count by 1")
    def test_21_verify_delete_tobacco_entry(self):
        self.tobacco_page.navigate_to_health_tab()
        now_before = datetime.datetime.now() - datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
        self.page.locator(TobaccoPage.CARD_HEADER_PLUS_BTN).click()
        self.tobacco_page.select_datetime(now_before)
        self.tobacco_page.enter_tobacco_count("5")
        self.tobacco_page.save_vital()
        self.tobacco_page.close_popup_if_present()
        self.page.locator(TobaccoPage.CARD_HEADER_HISTORY_BTN).click()
        self.tobacco_page.ensure_list_view()
        self.page.locator(TobaccoPage.DELETE_ROW_BTN).first.wait_for(state="attached", timeout=5000)
        initial_count = self.page.locator(TobaccoPage.DELETE_ROW_BTN).count()
        assert initial_count >= 1
        self.tobacco_page.accept_next_dialog()
        self.page.locator(TobaccoPage.DELETE_ROW_BTN).first.click()
        self.page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
        if self.page.locator(TobaccoPage.DELETE_ROW_BTN).count() == initial_count:
            self.page.reload()
            self.tobacco_page.navigate_to_health_tab()
            self.page.locator(TobaccoPage.CARD_HEADER_HISTORY_BTN).click()
            self.tobacco_page.ensure_list_view()
            self.page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
        final_count = self.page.locator(TobaccoPage.DELETE_ROW_BTN).count()
